summary: T. Rowe Price Group stock has recovered over the past three years, yet after a share price that is still down 33.7% over five years, the current valuation screens as cheap on both intrinsic value checks and earnings multiples. The question for investors is whether that apparent discount properly reflects the risks around its investing track record and fee based business model.
